subject: Onboarding: insurance requirements and PO timing for Aurora Systems
messages:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@aurorasys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@aurorasys.com
Date: Sun, 01 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding — docs needed to enable PO & insurance

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist you sent earlier. We're ready to move forward but want to confirm exactly which insurance items Redwood needs to issue a PO. Can you confirm whether the following will satisfy your intake process?

- COI (General Liability) listing Redwood Inference as additional insured and waiver of subrogation
- GL limits: $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate (is umbrella required?)
- Cyber liability certificate with at least $1M limits and retroactive date
- Completed W-9 (attached)
- Short subcontractor disclosure (we use two subconsultants)

We can send the COI and endorsement PDFs by EOD tomorrow. If there are any special wording/endorsement templates Redwood requires, please send them so we can request the correct forms from our broker. We are targetting a pilot PO to start services the week of 6/9 — is that timeline reasonable?

Attached: Aurora_Sys_W9.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lisa Hart
Director, Procurement
Aurora Systems
[Attachment: Aurora_Sys_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@aurorasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — docs needed to enable PO & insurance

Lisa — thanks for the clear list, that helps. Quick answers below and an outline of next steps: 

Required items (minimum)
- General Liability COI with limits at or above $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate.
- Umbrella/Excess recommended; if available, include umbrella limits and list Redwood Inference as an additional insured on the umbrella as well.
- Additional insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, its affiliates and their respective officers, directors and employees"; endorsement to be primary and non-contributory where possible.
- Cyber/Privacy Liability certificate with at least $1,000,000 limits and details on retroactive date and coverage scope.
- Waiver of subrogation on GL (if broker can provide).
- Completed W-9 (you attached — thank you).
- Subcontractor disclosure listing subcontractors and whether their coverage extends to the work for Redwood.

Procurement timing
- If we receive a valid COI + endorsement + W-9 and the procurement checklist is complete, procurement typically issues a conditional PO in 2–3 business days. Final PO may be issued after legal confirms endorsements.

What I attached
- Redwood_AddlInsured_Endorsement.pdf (this is our preferred endorsement language — ask your broker to confirm they can generate it).

Next steps
1) Please send the COI and any endorsement PDFs (or confirm broker can issue endorsement using our template).
2) Provide subcontractor list (name + scope + their COI if available).
3) I'll loop procurement once items are in and we can fast-track the PO.

If you want, we can set a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the endorsement language with your broker.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_AddlInsured_Endorsement.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@aurorasys.com>

Cc: procurements@aurorasys.com, risk@aurorasys.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — docs needed to enable PO & insurance

Ben — thanks, that is crystal clear. A couple quick follow-ups from our broker and internal risk: 

1) Endorsement: our broker indicated they can issue the AI endorsement but asked whether Redwood requires the endorsement to be on GL only or on both GL and umbrella. They can add it to both if required.
2) Subcontractors: we use two subconsultants (EdgeNet Labs and Kestrel Integrations). Do you need full COIs from them or is a subcontractor disclosure plus prime's coverage acceptable?
3) Retroactive date: our cyber policy has a 2019 retro date — should be fine, but risk asked whether Redwood needs any specific cyber sub-limits called out (e.g., incident response).

Attached: Aurora_Sys_Certificate.pdf (current COI) — endorsement not yet attached

On the PO timing: if the endorsement template is acceptable, we can request the broker to issue the endorsement by tomorrow and then push for the PO next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Lisa Hart
Director, Procurement
Aurora Systems
[Attachment: Aurora_Sys_Certificate.pdf (pdf)]

Looping in procurement and legal leads (Karthik) to confirm our acceptance path. Summary and recommended conditional plan: 

Summary of what Aurora sent: COI received (see attachment), endorsement pending. Broker can add AI to GL and to umbrella. Subcontractors noted (EdgeNet Labs, Kestrel Integrations) but no COIs from them yet.

Redwood recommendation: 
- Acceptable interim path: issue a conditional PO that enables the pilot start, contingent on final endorsement and subcontractor disclosure within 7 business days.
- Hard requirements: additional insured endorsement on GL (umbrella endorsement preferred), cyber certificate ≥ $1M, and subcontractor disclosure. Legal preference is for primary and non-contributory wording on the AI endorsement.
- If broker cannot provide AI endorsement on umbrella, require confirmation that umbrella applies to the work and that primary GL endorsement exists.

Action items and owners: 
- Ben: Confirm conditional PO language and timeline with procurement (2–3 business days once endorsement + W9 are in).
- Karthik: Quick review of the current COI and proposed endorsement (TBD) for any material gaps.
- Ben/Marissa: If legal requests a specific endorsement form change, loop the vendor and escalate to broker.

I'm attaching a short vendor risk summary to include in the procurement ticket so procurement can track the conditional acceptance and follow up for missing subcontractor COIs.

Attachments: vendor_risk_summary.docx (docx)

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
